toolsets.core: Diagnostics, organizations, locations, find and fleet health. Always on.
toolsets.devices: Device lists, search, profile, hardware, software, services, custom field values.
toolsets.reports: Fleet-wide /v2/queries reports: inventory, patches, antivirus, health, custom fields.
toolsets.actions: Device actions: reboot, scripts, services, patch scan and apply, maintenance, approval.
toolsets.policies: Policies, conditions, device roles, groups, scripts library, scheduled tasks.
toolsets.ticketing: Tickets, boards, forms, comments, ticket contacts.
toolsets.documentation: IT documentation: documents, templates, checklists, knowledge base.
toolsets.assets: ITAM: asset tags, software licenses, relationships, related items, unmanaged devices.
toolsets.custom_fields: Custom field definitions and global values.
toolsets.billing: PSA billing: accounts, agreements, invoices, products, ticket products.
toolsets.backup: Backup jobs, usage, integrity checks; vulnerability scan groups.
toolsets.admin: Account configuration: webhook, notification channels, custom tabs, node roles, installers.

tools.name: ninjaone_apply_os_patches
tools.title: Apply OS Patches
tools.description: Install approved OS patches on one device now. This can reboot the device per its policy. Never retried automatically. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_apply_software_patches
tools.title: Apply Software Patches
tools.description: Install approved third-party software patches on one device now. Never retried automatically. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_approve_devices
tools.title: Approve Devices
tools.description: Approve devices waiting in the pending queue (find them with ninjaone_list_devices and df "status = PENDING"). Dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne nodeApprovalOperation. Fields: devices (integer[]). Example: {"devices": [101, 102]}. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_cancel_device_maintenance
tools.title: Cancel Device Maintenance
tools.description: Cancel the pending or active maintenance window on one device. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_reboot_device
tools.title: Reboot Device
tools.description: Reboot one device now. NORMAL lets users save work where the OS allows; FORCED does not. Never retried automatically. Body (object) per NinjaOne rebootDevices. Fields: reason (string). Optional {"reason": "..."} shown in the activity log. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_reject_devices
tools.title: Reject Devices
tools.description: Reject devices waiting in the pending queue. Rejected devices are removed. Dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne nodeApprovalOperation. Fields: devices (integer[]). Example: {"devices": [101, 102]}. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_remove_device_owner
tools.title: Remove Device Owner
tools.description: Remove the owner from one device. Returns the device as it was, including the owner to restore. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_reset_alert
tools.title: Reset Alert
tools.description: Reset (clear) one alert. If the condition is still true it triggers again. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_reset_alert_with_activity
tools.title: Reset Alert With Activity
tools.description: Reset one alert and attach custom data to the activity it records, e.g. a ticket reference. Body (object) per NinjaOne resetAlertSetActivityData. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_reset_device_policy_overrides
tools.title: Reset Device Policy Overrides
tools.description: Remove every local policy override on one device, returning it to its policy. Returns the overrides as they were. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_retire_device
tools.title: Retire Device
tools.description: Decommission one device: it stops being monitored and managed. Returns the device record as it was. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_run_device_script
tools.title: Run Device Script
tools.description: Run a script or built-in action on one device. Get valid ids and parameters from ninjaone_get_device_scripting_options first. Needs the control scope. Never retried automatically; check the result with ninjaone_list_device_activities. Body (object) per NinjaOne runScriptOnDevice. Fields: type ("ACTION"|"SCRIPT"), id (integer), uid (string), parameters (string), runAs (string). Example: {"type": "SCRIPT", "id": 42, "parameters": "-Verbose", "runAs": "system"}. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_run_os_patch_scan
tools.title: Run OS Patch Scan
tools.description: Start an OS patch scan on one device. Results appear in ninjaone_list_device_os_patches when it finishes. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_run_software_patch_scan
tools.title: Run Software Patch Scan
tools.description: Start a third-party software patch scan on one device. Results appear in ninjaone_list_device_software_patches. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_run_windows_service_control
tools.title: Run Windows Service Control
tools.description: Start, stop, pause or restart a Windows service on one device. Find the service with ninjaone_list_device_services. Never retried automatically. Body (object) per NinjaOne controlWindowsService. Fields: action ("START"|"PAUSE"|"STOP"|"RESTART"). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_set_device_maintenance
tools.title: Set Device Maintenance
tools.description: Schedule a maintenance window on one device, suppressing alerts, patching, AV scans or tasks between start and end (epoch seconds). Undo with ninjaone_cancel_device_maintenance. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateDeviceMaintenance. Fields: disabledFeatures ("ALERTS"|"PATCHING"|"AVSCANS"|"TASKS"[]), start (number), end (number), reasonMessage (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_set_device_owner
tools.title: Set Device Owner
tools.description: Assign an end user as the owner of one device. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_set_windows_service_config
tools.title: Set Windows Service Config
tools.description: Change a Windows service's start type and run-as account on one device. Body (object) per NinjaOne setWindowsServiceConfiguration. Fields: startType ("AUTO_START"|"AUTO_START_DELAYED"|"BOOT_START"|"DEMAND_START"|"DISABLED"|"SYSTEM_START"), userName (string). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_device
tools.title: Update Device
tools.description: Update one device's display name, user data, policy, location, role or organization. Returns before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateDevice. Fields: displayName (string), userData (object), nodeRoleId (integer), policyId (integer), organizationId (integer), locationId (integer), warranty (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_device_custom_fields
tools.title: Update Device Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one device. Only the fields in body change. Returns before and after, so a change can be put back. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateNodeAttributeValues. Body maps custom field names to values, e.g. {"assetOwner": "Example User"}. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_custom_tab
tools.title: Create Custom Tab
tools.description: Creates a custom tab (name required) for a scope and entity. Returns the new tab; read it with ninjaone_get_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createCustomTabPublicApi. Fields: name (string, required), description (string), entityType ("NODE_ROLE"|"ORGANIZATION"|"END_USER"|"SYSTEM"|"GLOBAL"), entityId (integer), items (object[]), position (integer). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_custom_tab
tools.title: Delete Custom Tab
tools.description: Deletes a custom tab. Read it first with ninjaone_get_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Removes the account webhook configuration so no events are posted. Reconfigure with ninjaone_set_webhook. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_custom_installer
tools.title: Download Custom Installer
tools.description: Generate an agent installer URL with options (organization, location, role, usage limit, expiry). The URL is an enrollment secret. Body (object) per NinjaOne getInstaller. Fields: organizationId (integer), locationId (integer), installerType ("WINDOWS_MSI"|"WINDOWS_ARM64_MSI"|"MAC_DMG"|"MAC_PKG"|"LINUX_DEB"|"LINUX_RPM"|...), usageLimit (integer), content (object). Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_installer
tools.title: Download Installer
tools.description: Get the agent installer download URL for one location. The URL embeds an install token that enrolls devices into that client, so treat it as a secret. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_custom_tab
tools.title: Get Custom Tab
tools.description: Returns one custom tab definition with its items. Ids come from the list_*_custom_tabs tools. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_end_user_custom_tab
tools.title: Get End User Custom Tab
tools.description: Returns a custom tab as it appears at end user scope, with its field hierarchy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_org_custom_tab
tools.title: Get Org Custom Tab
tools.description: Returns a custom tab as it appears at organization scope, with its field hierarchy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_role_custom_tab
tools.title: Get Role Custom Tab
tools.description: Returns a custom tab as it appears for a device role, with its field hierarchy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_enabled_notification_channels
tools.title: List Enabled Notification Channels
tools.description: Lists enabled notification channels. Channel ids are used in alert and policy settings. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_end_user_custom_tabs
tools.title: List End User Custom Tabs
tools.description: Lists custom tabs at end user scope. Read one with ninjaone_get_end_user_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_global_custom_tabs
tools.title: List Global Custom Tabs
tools.description: Lists custom tabs at global scope with order and visibility. Read one with ninjaone_get_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_node_roles
tools.title: List Node Roles
tools.description: Lists device (node) roles with class and parent. Role ids are used in policies and custom tabs. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_notification_channels
tools.title: List Notification Channels
tools.description: Lists all notification channels with type and enabled state. Only the enabled ones: ninjaone_list_enabled_notification_channels. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_org_custom_tabs
tools.title: List Org Custom Tabs
tools.description: Lists custom tabs at organization scope. Read one with ninjaone_get_org_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_role_custom_tabs
tools.title: List Role Custom Tabs
tools.description: Lists custom tabs for a device role. Role ids come from ninjaone_list_node_roles. Read one with ninjaone_get_role_custom_tab. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_set_webhook
tools.title: Set Webhook
tools.description: Replaces the account webhook configuration (URL, activity types, headers). NinjaOne will post events to that URL, so confirm the destination. Remove it with ninjaone_delete_webhook. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne configureWebhook. Fields: url (string), activities (object), expand (string[]), headers (object[]), organizationIds (integer[]). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_custom_tab
tools.title: Update Custom Tab
tools.description: Updates a custom tab's fields. Returns the tab before and after. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne updateCustomTabPublicApi. Fields: roleId (integer), items (object[]), position (integer). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_activities
tools.title: List Activities
tools.description: List activity log entries across devices (newest first), narrowed with df and filters. Paged backwards in time.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_alerts
tools.title: List Alerts
tools.description: List active alerts (triggered conditions) across devices, narrowed with df. Then ninjaone_get_device_profile on a device, or ninjaone_reset_alert once handled.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_backup_jobs
tools.title: List Backup Jobs
tools.description: Lists backup jobs with status, plan, size and device. Narrow with a device filter. Pair with ninjaone_list_integrity_check_jobs.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_activities
tools.title: List Device Activities
tools.description: List one device's activity log (scripts, patches, alerts, actions), newest first, paged backwards in time.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_alerts
tools.title: List Device Alerts
tools.description: List one device's active alerts (triggered conditions). For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_jobs
tools.title: List Device Jobs
tools.description: List one device's currently running jobs (scripts, patching, actions). For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_jobs
tools.title: List Jobs
tools.description: List jobs running now across devices (scripts, patching, actions), narrowed with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_api_get
tools.title: API Get
tools.description: Call any NinjaOne Public API GET under /v2/ that no typed tool covers (docs/api-coverage.md lists them). Prefer a typed tool: it pages, scopes and shapes results. Refused while NINJAONE_ALLOWED_ORG_IDS is set, because raw paths cannot be held inside the boundary. Secure custom field values are never requested, and signed-URL routes are refused.

tools.name: ninjaone_api_write
tools.title: API Write
tools.description: Send a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE to any NinjaOne Public API path under /v2/ that no typed tool covers. Destructive tier: nothing checks what the call changes, so it needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true, and is refused while NINJAONE_ALLOWED_ORG_IDS is set. Never retried automatically.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_asset_relationships
tools.title: Create Asset Relationships
tools.description: Creates relationships between records; each item has a source, a target and a relation type. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_entity_relations. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createAssetRelationship. Each item: Fields: sourceId (integer), sourceType ("DEVICE"|"CHECKLIST"|"CONTACT"|"CREDENTIAL"|"APPS_SERVICES_DOCUMENT"|"TECHNICIAN"|...), targetId (integer), targetType ("DEVICE"|"CHECKLIST"|"CONTACT"|"CREDENTIAL"|"APPS_SERVICES_DOCUMENT"|"TECHNICIAN"|...), relationshipTypeId (integer). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_asset_tag
tools.title: Create Asset Tag
tools.description: Creates one asset tag. Returns the new tag; verify with ninjaone_list_asset_tags. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createTag. Fields: name (string), description (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_related_item
tools.title: Create Related Item
tools.description: Links one record to another as a related item (no file upload). Verify with ninjaone_list_entity_related_items. Body (object) per NinjaOne createRelatedItemForEntity. Fields: relEntityType ("ORGANIZATION"|"DOCUMENT"|"LOCATION"|"NODE"|"ATTACHMENT"|"TECHNICIAN"|...), relEntityId (integer). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_related_items
tools.title: Create Related Items
tools.description: Links one record to several others in one call. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_entity_related_items. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createRelatedItemForEntity_1. Each item: Fields: relEntityType ("ORGANIZATION"|"DOCUMENT"|"LOCATION"|"NODE"|"ATTACHMENT"|"TECHNICIAN"|...), relEntityId (integer). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_relationship_type
tools.title: Create Relationship Type
tools.description: Creates a relationship type (forwardLabel, reverseLabel, description). Verify with ninjaone_list_relationship_types. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createRelationshipType. Fields: forwardLabel (string, required), reverseLabel (string, required), description (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_secure_related_item
tools.title: Create Secure Related Item
tools.description: Attaches a secure value (such as a credential) to a record as a related item. The value goes in the request body only; it is not echoed by this server. Body (object) per NinjaOne createSecureRelatedItemForEntity. Fields: name (string), url (string), notes (string), username (string), password (string), totpSecret (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_software_license
tools.title: Create Software License
tools.description: Creates one software license. Returns the new license; verify with ninjaone_get_software_license. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne create. Fields: name (string, required), description (string, required), type ("PER_DEVICE"|"PER_USER"|"CUSTOM", required), purchaseDate (integer, required), publisherId (integer, required), vendorId (integer, required), scope (object, required), quantity (integer, required), currentUsage (integer, required), term (object, required), notificationChannelInfo (object, required), assigmentAutomationSettings (object), assignedLicenses (object), unassignedLicenses (object), note (string), costMode ("TOTAL"|"PER_LICENSE"), cost (number), usageMonitoring (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_staged_device
tools.title: Create Staged Device
tools.description: Creates a staged device record (a device registered before its agent installs) for an organization and location. Returns the staged device. Body (object) per NinjaOne createStagedDevice. Fields: name (string, required), orgId (integer, required), locationId (integer, required), roleId (integer, required), assignedUserUid (string), warrantyStartDate (number), warrantyEndDate (number), itamAssetId (string), itamAssetStatus (string), itamAssetPurchaseDate (number), itamAssetPurchaseAmount (number), itamAssetExpectedLifetime (string), itamAssetEndOfLifeDate (number), itamAssetSerialNumber (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_unmanaged_device
tools.title: Create Unmanaged Device
tools.description: Creates an unmanaged device (one without an agent) in an organization. Returns the new device with its node id; use ninjaone_update_unmanaged_device to change it. Body (object) per NinjaOne createUnmanagedDevicePublicApi. Fields: name (string, required), orgId (integer, required), locationId (integer, required), roleId (integer, required), assignedUserUid (string), warrantyStartDate (number), warrantyEndDate (number), assetFields (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_asset_relationships
tools.title: Delete Asset Relationships
tools.description: Deletes relationships by id (maximum 100). Find ids with ninjaone_list_entity_relations (relationId). Runs as a dry run by default. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_asset_tag
tools.title: Delete Asset Tag
tools.description: Deletes one asset tag and removes it from every asset. Returns nothing on success. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_asset_tags
tools.title: Delete Asset Tags
tools.description: Permanently delete several asset tags by id. Tagged assets lose the tag. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne deleteTags. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_entity_related_items
tools.title: Delete Entity Related Items
tools.description: Deletes every related item of one record. List them first with ninjaone_list_entity_related_items. Runs as a dry run by default. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_related_item
tools.title: Delete Related Item
tools.description: Deletes one related item (the link, not the records it joins). Find the id with ninjaone_list_entity_related_items. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_software_license
tools.title: Delete Software License
tools.description: Deletes one software license and its assignments. Returns the license as it was in before. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_unmanaged_device
tools.title: Delete Unmanaged Device
tools.description: Permanently deletes one unmanaged device and its history. Prefer ninjaone_retire_unmanaged_device. Returns nothing on success. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_related_item_attachment
tools.title: Download Related Item Attachment
tools.description: Downloads the file attached to one related item. The file may hold secrets. Find the id with ninjaone_list_entity_related_items. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_related_item_files
tools.title: Download Related Item Files
tools.description: Returns signed download URLs for every attachment related to one record. The URLs are bearer links: do not share them. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_software_license
tools.title: Get Software License
tools.description: Gets one software license with its assignment list, cost and term. Find the id with ninjaone_list_software_licenses. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_asset_relationships
tools.title: List Asset Relationships
tools.description: Lists asset relationships across the account, optionally of one relation type. For one record use ninjaone_list_entity_relations. Types come from ninjaone_list_relationship_types.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_asset_tags
tools.title: List Asset Tags
tools.description: Lists asset tags with their ids. Use it to find tag ids for ninjaone_set_asset_tags or ninjaone_update_asset_tag_assignments. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_entity_related_items
tools.title: List Entity Related Items
tools.description: Lists the related items of one record (a document, device, organization and so on). Returns compact rows; request fields for the linked entities.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_entity_relations
tools.title: List Entity Relations
tools.description: Lists the relationships of one record (device, checklist, contact and so on), as source, target or both. Returns compact rows.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_license_assignments
tools.title: List License Assignments
tools.description: Lists who or what holds seats of one software license, with last use time. Find the license with ninjaone_list_software_licenses. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_related_items
tools.title: List Related Items
tools.description: Lists every related item in the account. Usually too broad: prefer ninjaone_list_entity_related_items for one record. Returns compact rows.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_related_items_by_host_type
tools.title: List Related Items By Host Type
tools.description: Lists related items hosted by records of one type, for example every item attached to a document. Can be large; page with cursor.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_related_items_by_target
tools.title: List Related Items By Target
tools.description: Lists related items that point at one record (the reverse lookup: which records link to this one). Returns compact rows.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_related_items_by_target_type
tools.title: List Related Items By Target Type
tools.description: Lists related items whose linked record is of one type, for example every item that links to a technician. Can be large; page with cursor.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_relationship_types
tools.title: List Relationship Types
tools.description: Lists relationship types with their forward and reverse labels. Use it before ninjaone_create_asset_relationships. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_software_licenses
tools.title: List Software Licenses
tools.description: Lists software licenses with seat usage and expiry. Then ninjaone_get_software_license or ninjaone_list_license_assignments. Returns compact rows. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_retire_unmanaged_device
tools.title: Retire Unmanaged Device
tools.description: Decommissions one unmanaged device: it leaves the active inventory. Prefer this to ninjaone_delete_unmanaged_device. Returns nothing on success. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_retire_unmanaged_devices
tools.title: Retire Unmanaged Devices
tools.description: Decommissions many unmanaged devices at once (nodeIds, at most 100). Runs as a dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne decommissionUnmanagedDevicePublicApiList. Fields: nodeIds (integer[], required). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.description: Set global custom field values. Only the fields in body change. Returns before and after. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne updateGlobalCustomFields. Body maps custom field names to values. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device
tools.title: Get Device
tools.description: Get one device: class, organization, location, policy, role, OS, system, maintenance and references. For hardware, volumes and patches in one call use ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device_custom_fields
tools.title: Get Device Custom Fields
tools.description: Get one device's custom field values. Secure fields are never revealed. To change them, ninjaone_update_device_custom_fields.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device_last_user
tools.title: Get Device Last User
tools.description: Get the last logged-on user of one device and when they logged on.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device_link
tools.title: Get Device Link
tools.description: Get the NinjaOne console URL for one device, to hand a person a direct link. The link needs a console login.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device_profile
tools.title: Get Device Profile
tools.description: Everything about one device in one call: the device record, last logged-on user, volumes, disks, processors, network interfaces, active alerts, and pending/failed OS and software patch counts. Each part reports its own error instead of failing the whole call. Use it to triage a device; then ninjaone_list_device_activities for history or ninjaone_get_device_scripting_options to act.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_device_scripting_options
tools.title: Get Device Scripting Options
tools.description: List the scripts and built-in actions that can run on one device, with their ids and parameters. Call this before ninjaone_run_device_script.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_location_custom_fields
tools.title: Get Location Custom Fields
tools.description: Get the custom field values set on one location of an organization.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_org_custom_fields
tools.title: Get Org Custom Fields
tools.description: Get the custom field values set on one organization. Secure fields are never revealed. To change them, ninjaone_update_org_custom_fields.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_custom_field_definitions
tools.title: List Device Custom Field Definitions
tools.description: List the custom field definitions that apply to devices, locations and organizations (names, labels, types). Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_disks
tools.title: List Device Disks
tools.description: List one device's physical disk drives. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_geolocation
tools.title: List Device Geolocation
tools.description: List one device's geolocation history (where location tracking is enabled).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_network_interfaces
tools.title: List Device Network Interfaces
tools.description: List one device's network interfaces with IP and MAC addresses. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_os_patch_installs
tools.title: List Device OS Patch Installs
tools.description: List one device's OS patch install history. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_os_patches
tools.title: List Device OS Patches
tools.description: List one device's pending, failed and rejected OS patches. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_policy_overrides
tools.title: List Device Policy Overrides
tools.description: Summarize the policy settings this device overrides locally.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_processors
tools.title: List Device Processors
tools.description: List one device's processors. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_services
tools.title: List Device Services
tools.description: List one device's Windows services with state and start type. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_software
tools.title: List Device Software
tools.description: List one device's installed software inventory. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_software_patch_installs
tools.title: List Device Software Patch Installs
tools.description: List one device's third-party software patch install history. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_software_patches
tools.title: List Device Software Patches
tools.description: List one device's pending, failed and rejected third-party software patches. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_volumes
tools.title: List Device Volumes
tools.description: List one device's storage volumes with capacity and free space. For the same data across many devices, use the matching ninjaone_report_* tool with df.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_devices
tools.title: List Devices
tools.description: List devices, compact by default, narrowed with df. Then ninjaone_get_device_profile for detail on one device. For free-text lookup use ninjaone_search_devices.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_devices_detailed
tools.title: List Devices Detailed
tools.description: List devices with OS, system, last logged-on user and references. Heavier than ninjaone_list_devices; pass fields to keep it small.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_org_devices
tools.title: List Org Devices
tools.description: List the devices of one organization (compact by default). Then ninjaone_get_device or ninjaone_get_device_profile for one device.

tools.name: ninjaone_search_devices
tools.title: Search Devices
tools.description: Find devices by name, logged-on user, IP or MAC address. Returns matching devices with ids.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_location_custom_fields
tools.title: Update Location Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one location. Only the fields in body change. Returns before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateNodeAttributeValues_2. Body maps custom field names to values. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_org_custom_fields
tools.title: Update Org Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one organization. Only the fields in body change. Returns the values before and after, so a change can be put back. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateNodeAttributeValues_1. Body maps custom field names to values, e.g. {"contractTier": "gold"}. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_checklist_templates
tools.title: Archive Checklist Templates
tools.description: Archives checklist templates by id (checklistTemplateIds); undo with ninjaone_restore_checklist_templates. Runs as a dry run by default. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne archiveChecklistTemplate. Fields: checklistTemplateIds (integer[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_checklists
tools.title: Archive Checklists
tools.description: Archives organization checklists by id (clientChecklistIds); undo with ninjaone_restore_checklists. Runs as a dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne archiveOrganizationChecklists. Fields: clientChecklistIds (integer[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_document
tools.title: Archive Document
tools.description: Archives one document; it can be brought back with ninjaone_restore_document. Returns the archived document. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_document_template
tools.title: Archive Document Template
tools.description: Archives one document template; undo with ninjaone_restore_document_template. Returns nothing on success. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_document_templates
tools.title: Archive Document Templates
tools.description: Archive several document templates by id. Undo with ninjaone_restore_document_templates. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne archiveDocumentTemplates. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_documents
tools.title: Archive Documents
tools.description: Archive several organization documents by id. Archived documents can be brought back with ninjaone_restore_documents. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne archiveMultiPageClientDocuments. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_kb_articles
tools.title: Archive KB Articles
tools.description: Archive knowledge base articles by id. Undo with ninjaone_restore_kb_articles. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne archiveKnowledgeBaseArticles. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_archive_kb_folders
tools.title: Archive KB Folders
tools.description: Archive knowledge base folders (and their contents) by id. Undo with ninjaone_restore_kb_folders. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne archiveKnowledgeBaseFolders. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_checklist_templates
tools.title: Create Checklist Templates
tools.description: Creates checklist templates with their tasks. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_checklist_templates. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createChecklistTemplates. Each item: Fields: name (string), description (object), tasks (object[]), required (boolean). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_checklists
tools.title: Create Checklists
tools.description: Creates organization checklists with their tasks; each item names its organization. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_checklists. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createOrganizationChecklists. Each item: Fields: name (string), description (object), required (boolean), dueDate (number), assignedToUserId (integer), organizationId (integer), checklistTemplateId (integer), tasks (object[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_checklists_from_templates
tools.title: Create Checklists From Templates
tools.description: Create checklists in one organization from checklist templates (find ids with ninjaone_list_checklist_templates). Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne createOrganizationChecklistsFromTemplates. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_document
tools.title: Create Document
tools.description: Creates one document for an organization from a document template. Find the template with ninjaone_list_document_templates first. Returns the new document; verify with ninjaone_list_organization_documents. Body (object) per NinjaOne createOrganizationDocument. Fields: documentName (string), documentDescription (string), fields (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_document_template
tools.title: Create Document Template
tools.description: Creates a document template with its field definitions. Returns the new template; verify with ninjaone_get_document_template. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createDocumentTemplate. Fields: name (string, required), description (string), allowMultiple (boolean), mandatory (boolean), fields (object[]), availableToAllTechnicians (boolean), allowedTechnicianRoles (integer[]). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_documents
tools.title: Create Documents
tools.description: Creates many documents in one call; each item names its organization and template. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_documents. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createOrganizationDocuments. Each item: Fields: documentName (string), documentDescription (string), fields (object), documentTemplateId (integer), organizationId (integer). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_kb_articles
tools.title: Create KB Articles
tools.description: Creates knowledge base articles; each item names its organization (or none for global) and destination folder. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_kb_articles. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne createKnowledgeBaseArticles. Each item: Fields: name (string), organizationId (integer), destinationFolderId (integer), destinationFolderPath (string), content (object). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_templates_from_checklist_ids
tools.title: Create Templates From Checklist IDs
tools.description: Turn organization checklists into reusable checklist templates, keeping their names. To rename while promoting use ninjaone_create_templates_from_checklists. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne promoteClientChecklists_1. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_templates_from_checklists
tools.title: Create Templates From Checklists
tools.description: Promotes organization checklists into checklist templates, each with a name you choose. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_checklist_templates. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne promoteClientChecklists. Each item: Fields: id (integer), name (string). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_checklist
tools.title: Delete Checklist
tools.description: Permanently deletes one organization checklist. Prefer ninjaone_archive_checklists. Returns nothing on success. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_checklist_template
tools.title: Delete Checklist Template
tools.description: Permanently deletes one checklist template. Prefer ninjaone_archive_checklist_templates. Returns nothing on success. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_checklist_templates
tools.title: Delete Checklist Templates
tools.description: Permanently delete several checklist templates by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne deleteChecklistTemplates. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_checklists
tools.title: Delete Checklists
tools.description: Permanently delete several organization checklists by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne deleteClientChecklists. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_document
tools.title: Delete Document
tools.description: Permanently deletes one document. Prefer ninjaone_archive_document, which can be undone. Returns nothing on success. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_document_template
tools.title: Delete Document Template
tools.description: Permanently deletes one document template. Prefer ninjaone_archive_document_template. Returns the template as it was in before. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_kb_articles
tools.title: Delete KB Articles
tools.description: Permanently delete knowledge base articles by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne deleteKnowledgeBaseArticles. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_kb_folders
tools.title: Delete KB Folders
tools.description: Permanently delete knowledge base folders and their contents by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne deleteKnowledgeBaseFolders. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_checklist_files
tools.title: Download Checklist Files
tools.description: Returns signed download URLs for the files attached to one checklist. The URLs are bearer links: do not share them. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_document_files
tools.title: Download Document Files
tools.description: Returns signed download URLs for the files attached to one document. The URLs are bearer links: anyone holding one can fetch the file, so do not share them. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_kb_article
tools.title: Download KB Article
tools.description: Downloads one knowledge base article as a file. The content may hold secrets; read it only when you need the file itself, otherwise use ninjaone_get_kb_article. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_download_kb_article_files
tools.title: Download KB Article Files
tools.description: Returns signed download URLs for the attachments of one knowledge base article. The URLs are bearer links: do not share them. Returns secret values (signed or tokenized URLs): requires reveal: true and both write gates. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_checklist
tools.title: Get Checklist
tools.description: Gets one organization checklist with its tasks. Find the id with ninjaone_list_checklists. Returns the full checklist.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_document_template
tools.title: Get Document Template
tools.description: Gets one document template with all its field definitions. Use it to learn which fields a document needs; then ninjaone_create_document. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_global_kb_article
tools.title: Get Global KB Article
tools.description: Gets one global knowledge base article with its content. Find the id with ninjaone_list_global_kb_articles. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_kb_article
tools.title: Get KB Article
tools.description: Gets one organization knowledge base article with its content. Find the id with ninjaone_list_kb_articles.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_kb_folder
tools.title: Get KB Folder
tools.description: Gets one knowledge base folder by id with its sub-folders and articles. Use ninjaone_get_kb_folder_by_path when you only know the path.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_kb_folder_by_path
tools.title: Get KB Folder By Path
tools.description: Gets a knowledge base folder by path (or id) within an organization, with its sub-folders and articles. Pass org to name the organization. Use it to browse the tree; then ninjaone_get_kb_article.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_checklist_templates
tools.title: List Checklist Templates
tools.description: Lists checklist templates, optionally by id or name. Use it to find template ids for ninjaone_update_checklist_templates. Returns compact rows. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_checklists
tools.title: List Checklists
tools.description: Lists organization checklists with progress counts, filtered by organization, name, assignee or state. Use it to find a checklist id; then ninjaone_get_checklist for the tasks. Returns compact rows.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_document_templates
tools.title: List Document Templates
tools.description: Lists document templates with their field definitions. Use it to find a template id before ninjaone_create_document. Returns compact rows; request fields (such as fields) for the definitions. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_documents
tools.title: List Documents
tools.description: Lists organization documents with their field values across organizations, filtered by template or name. Use it to find a document id and its organization; use ninjaone_list_organization_documents for one organization. Returns compact rows; request fields for more.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_global_kb_articles
tools.title: List Global KB Articles
tools.description: Lists global (account-wide) knowledge base articles, optionally by name. Then ninjaone_get_global_kb_article. Returns compact rows. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_kb_articles
tools.title: List KB Articles
tools.description: Lists organization knowledge base articles, optionally by organization or name. Use it to find an article id; then ninjaone_get_kb_article. For account-wide articles use ninjaone_list_global_kb_articles. Returns compact rows.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_organization_documents
tools.title: List Organization Documents
tools.description: Lists every document of one organization, with field values. Use it when you already know the organization; use ninjaone_list_documents to search across organizations. Returns compact rows; request fields for more.

tools.name: ninjaone_move_kb_items
tools.title: Move KB Items
tools.description: Moves knowledge base folders and articles (folderIds, documentIds) into a destination folder or organization. Runs as a dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne move. Fields: folderIds (integer[]), documentIds (integer[]), destinationFolderId (integer), destinationOrganizationId (integer). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_checklist_templates
tools.title: Restore Checklist Templates
tools.description: Restores archived checklist templates by id (checklistTemplateIds). Runs as a dry run by default. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne restoreChecklistTemplate. Fields: checklistTemplateIds (integer[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_checklists
tools.title: Restore Checklists
tools.description: Restores archived organization checklists by id (clientChecklistIds). Runs as a dry run by default. Body (object) per NinjaOne restoreOrganizationChecklists. Fields: clientChecklistIds (integer[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_document
tools.title: Restore Document
tools.description: Restores one archived document. Returns the restored document. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_document_template
tools.title: Restore Document Template
tools.description: Restores one archived document template. Returns the restored template. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_document_templates
tools.title: Restore Document Templates
tools.description: Restore several archived document templates by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne restoreDocumentTemplates. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_documents
tools.title: Restore Documents
tools.description: Restore several archived organization documents by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne restoreMultiPageClientDocuments. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_kb_articles
tools.title: Restore KB Articles
tools.description: Restore archived knowledge base articles by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne restoreKnowledgeBaseArticles. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_restore_kb_folders
tools.title: Restore KB Folders
tools.description: Restore archived knowledge base folders by id. Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne restoreKnowledgeBaseFolders. Example: [101, 102]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_checklist_templates
tools.title: Update Checklist Templates
tools.description: Replaces checklist templates; each item names the template id. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_checklist_templates. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne updateChecklistTemplates. Each item: Fields: id (integer), name (string), description (object), tasks (object[]), required (boolean). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_checklists
tools.title: Update Checklists
tools.description: Updates organization checklists and their tasks; each item names the checklist. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_get_checklist. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne updateOrganizationChecklists. Each item: Fields: checklistId (integer), name (string), description (object), required (boolean), dueDate (number), assignedToUserId (integer), tasks (object[]). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_document
tools.title: Update Document
tools.description: Updates one document of an organization (name, description, field values). Find the document id with ninjaone_list_organization_documents. Returns the updated field values. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateOrganizationDocument. Fields: documentName (string), documentDescription (string), fields (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_document_template
tools.title: Update Document Template
tools.description: Replaces a document template definition. Read it first with ninjaone_get_document_template and send the full definition. Returns before and after. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne updateDocumentTemplate. Fields: name (string), description (string), mandatory (boolean), fields (object[]), availableToAllTechnicians (boolean), allowedTechnicianRoles (integer[]). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_documents
tools.title: Update Documents
tools.description: Updates many documents in one call; each item names the document and its new values. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_list_documents. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne updateOrganizationDocuments. Each item: Fields: documentId (integer), documentName (string), documentDescription (string), fields (object). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_kb_articles
tools.title: Update KB Articles
tools.description: Updates knowledge base articles; each item names the article and its new values. Runs as a dry run by default. Verify with ninjaone_get_kb_article. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne updateKnowledgeBaseArticles. Each item: Fields: id (integer), name (string), content (object). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_policy
tools.title: Create Policy
tools.description: Create a policy: new, as a child of another policy, or as a copy. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createPolicy. Fields: parentPolicyId (integer), name (string), description (string), nodeClass ("WINDOWS_SERVER"|"WINDOWS_WORKSTATION"|"LINUX_WORKSTATION"|"MAC"|"ANDROID"|"APPLE_IOS"|...), enabled (boolean). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_policy_custom_field_condition
tools.title: Create Policy Custom Field Condition
tools.description: Add a custom-field condition (alert when a field matches) to a policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createCustomFieldsPolicyCondition. Fields: enabled (boolean), displayName (string), severity ("NONE"|"MINOR"|"MODERATE"|"MAJOR"|"CRITICAL"), priority ("NONE"|"LOW"|"MEDIUM"|"HIGH"), channels (integer[]), scripts (object[]), notificationAction ("NONE"|"SEND"), notifyOnReset (boolean), resetThreshold (integer), matchAll (object[]), matchAny (object[]). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_policy_windows_event_condition
tools.title: Create Policy Windows Event Condition
tools.description: Add a Windows event log condition (alert on event id and source) to a policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createWindowsEventPolicyCondition. Fields: source (string, required), eventIds (integer[], required), enabled (boolean), displayName (string), severity ("NONE"|"MINOR"|"MODERATE"|"MAJOR"|"CRITICAL"), priority ("NONE"|"LOW"|"MEDIUM"|"HIGH"), channels (integer[]), scripts (object[]), notificationAction ("NONE"|"SEND"), notifyOnReset (boolean), resetThreshold (integer), text (object), occurrence (object). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_policy_condition
tools.title: Delete Policy Condition
tools.description: Delete one condition from a policy. Read it first with the matching get tool if you may need to recreate it. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_policy_custom_field_condition
tools.title: Get Policy Custom Field Condition
tools.description: Get one custom-field condition of a policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_get_policy_windows_event_condition
tools.title: Get Policy Windows Event Condition
tools.description: Get one Windows event log condition of a policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_device_roles
tools.title: List Device Roles
tools.description: List device roles (Windows Server, Workstation, custom roles) with ids, used in policy mappings and df "role = <id>". Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_group_devices
tools.title: List Group Devices
tools.description: List the device ids in one group. For full rows use ninjaone_list_devices with df "group = <id>", which also respects the organization boundary.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_groups
tools.title: List Groups
tools.description: List device groups (saved searches). Use a group id in df as "group = <id>", or ninjaone_list_group_devices. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_policies
tools.title: List Policies
tools.description: List policies with id, name, node class and parent policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_policy_custom_field_conditions
tools.title: List Policy Custom Field Conditions
tools.description: List the custom-field conditions of one policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_policy_windows_event_conditions
tools.title: List Policy Windows Event Conditions
tools.description: List the Windows event log conditions of one policy. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_scheduled_tasks
tools.title: List Scheduled Tasks
tools.description: List scheduled tasks (recurring script and action schedules). Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_scripts
tools.title: List Scripts
tools.description: List automation scripts in the library with ids, language and OS. To run one, ninjaone_get_device_scripting_options then ninjaone_run_device_script. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_software_products
tools.title: List Software Products
tools.description: List the third-party software products NinjaOne can patch, with product ids used in patch filters. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_set_org_policy_mappings
tools.title: Set Org Policy Mappings
tools.description: Replace the organization's device-role-to-policy mappings. This is a full replacement: any mapping not in body is removed. Dry run by default; the result includes the organization as it was (before), which is the undo. Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne updateNodeRolePolicyAssignmentForOrganization. Each item: Fields: nodeRoleId (integer), policyId (integer). Send every mapping you want to keep. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_antivirus_threats

tools.name: ninjaone_report_network_interfaces
tools.title: Report Network Interfaces
tools.description: Report network interfaces with IP and MAC addresses across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_operating_systems
tools.title: Report Operating Systems
tools.description: Report operating systems, versions, builds and last boot across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.description: Report pending, failed and rejected OS patches across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_policy_overrides
tools.title: Report Policy Overrides
tools.description: Report local policy overrides per device across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_processors
tools.title: Report Processors
tools.description: Report processors across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.title: Report RAID Controllers
tools.description: Report RAID controllers across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.title: Report RAID Drives
tools.description: Report RAID physical drives and their status across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_scoped_custom_fields
tools.title: Report Scoped Custom Fields
tools.description: Report custom field values on organizations, locations and end users (secure values are never included) across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_scoped_custom_fields_detailed
tools.title: Report Scoped Custom Fields Detailed
tools.description: Report scoped custom field values with metadata (secure values are never included) across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.title: Report Software
tools.description: Report installed software (name, publisher, version, install date) across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.description: Report third-party software patch install history across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.description: Report pending, failed and rejected third-party software patches across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.
