tools.title: Report Volumes
tools.description: Report storage volumes with capacity and free space across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_report_windows_services
tools.title: Report Windows Services
tools.description: Report Windows services and their state across devices, one row per item, cursor paged. Narrow with df (device filter). Use it for fleet questions; follow up on one device with ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add Ticket Comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket: public (visible to the requester) or internal, as plain text or HTML, optionally with time tracked. Returns the result; read the ticket's log with ninjaone_list_ticket_log_entries. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_ticket
tools.title: Create Ticket
tools.description: Creates a ticket. Requires clientId, ticketFormId, subject and status; find them with ninjaone_list_organizations, ninjaone_list_ticket_forms and ninjaone_list_ticket_statuses. Returns the new ticket; read it with ninjaone_get_ticket. Body (object) per NinjaOne create_2. Fields: clientId (integer, required), ticketFormId (integer, required), subject (string, required), status (string, required), locationId (integer), nodeId (integer), description (object), type ("PROBLEM"|"QUESTION"|"INCIDENT"|"TASK"|"CHANGE_REQUEST"|"SERVICE_REQUEST"|...), cc (object), assignedAppUserId (integer), requesterUid (string), severity ("NONE"|"MINOR"|"MODERATE"|"MAJOR"|"CRITICAL"), priority ("NONE"|"LOW"|"MEDIUM"|"HIGH"), parentTicketId (integer), tags (string[]), attributes (object[]), additionalAssignedTechnicianIds (integer[]), followupTime (number). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_ticket
tools.title: Get Ticket
tools.description: Returns one ticket: subject, status, type, priority, client, assignee, tags and attribute values. Use ninjaone_list_ticket_log_entries for its comments and history.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_ticket_form
tools.title: Get Ticket Form
tools.description: Returns one ticket form with its fields. Use it to see which attributes a ticket created from the form needs. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_board_tickets
tools.title: List Board Tickets
tools.description: List the tickets on a ticketing board (find boards with ninjaone_list_ticket_boards), with optional search and sort. Cursor paged. Then ninjaone_get_ticket for one ticket.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_attributes
tools.title: List Ticket Attributes
tools.description: Lists ticket attributes (custom ticket fields) with type and options. Attribute ids are used in the attributes array when creating or updating a ticket. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_boards
tools.title: List Ticket Boards
tools.description: Lists ticket boards (saved ticket views) with id, name and ticket count. Use it to find a board id; read the tickets on a board with ninjaone_list_board_tickets. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_contacts
tools.title: List Ticket Contacts
tools.description: Lists ticketing contacts with client, name, email and job title. Use ninjaone_list_ticket_users to search technicians, end users and contacts together.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_forms
tools.title: List Ticket Forms
tools.description: Lists ticket forms (templates that define ticket fields). Use a form id as ticketFormId when creating a ticket; inspect one with ninjaone_get_ticket_form. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_log_entries
tools.title: List Ticket Log Entries
tools.description: Lists a ticket's log entries (description, comments, saves, products), newest paging by anchor id. Add a comment with ninjaone_add_ticket_comment.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_statuses
tools.title: List Ticket Statuses
tools.description: Lists ticket statuses with name, display name and id. Use a status name when creating or updating a ticket. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_ticket_users
tools.title: List Ticket Users
tools.description: Searches technicians, end users and contacts that can be set on a ticket (requester, assignee, cc). Returns uid and id to use in ninjaone_create_ticket.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_ticket
tools.title: Update Ticket
tools.description: Updates a ticket (status, assignee, priority, tags, attributes). Returns the ticket before and after the change. Body (object) per NinjaOne update_2. Fields: version (integer, required), clientId (integer, required), ticketFormId (integer, required), subject (string, required), status (string, required), requesterUid (string, required), locationId (integer), nodeId (integer), type ("PROBLEM"|"QUESTION"|"INCIDENT"|"TASK"|"CHANGE_REQUEST"|"SERVICE_REQUEST"|...), cc (object), assignedAppUserId (integer), severity ("NONE"|"MINOR"|"MODERATE"|"MAJOR"|"CRITICAL"), priority ("NONE"|"LOW"|"MEDIUM"|"HIGH"), parentTicketId (integer), tags (string[]), attributes (object[]), additionalAssignedTechnicianIds (integer[]), followupTime (number). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_add_role_members
tools.title: Add Role Members
tools.description: Add users to a technician or end-user role. Find role ids with ninjaone_list_user_roles and user ids with ninjaone_list_technicians. Dry run by default. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne addUserRoleMembers. Example: [12, 15]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_contact
tools.title: Create Contact
tools.description: Creates a contact (email required, organizationId optional). Returns the new contact. Body (object) per NinjaOne createContact. Fields: email (string, required), organizationId (integer), firstName (string), lastName (string), phone (string), jobTitle (string), managerUuid (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_end_user
tools.title: Create End User
tools.description: Creates an end user (first name, last name, email required). Optionally sends the invitation email. Returns the new user. Body (object) per NinjaOne createEndUser. Fields: firstName (string, required), lastName (string, required), email (string, required), phone (string), organizationId (integer), fullPortalAccess (boolean), managerUid (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_create_technician
tools.title: Create Technician
tools.description: Creates a technician. Role ids come from ninjaone_list_user_roles. Returns the new technician. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne createTechnician. Fields: firstName (string, required), lastName (string, required), email (string, required), phone (string), managerUid (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_contact
tools.title: Delete Contact
tools.description: Deletes a contact. Read it first with ninjaone_get_contact. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_end_user
tools.title: Delete End User
tools.description: Deletes an end user. Read it first with ninjaone_get_end_user. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_delete_technician
tools.title: Delete Technician
tools.description: Deletes a technician. Read it first with ninjaone_get_technician. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_contact
tools.title: Get Contact
tools.description: Get one contact: name, email, phone, job title and organization. Then ninjaone_update_contact to change it.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_end_user
tools.title: Get End User
tools.description: Returns one end user with roles and device access.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_end_user_custom_fields
tools.title: Get End User Custom Fields
tools.description: Returns the custom field values of an end user as a field-name map.

tools.name: ninjaone_get_technician
tools.title: Get Technician
tools.description: Returns one technician with roles and assigned devices. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_contacts
tools.title: List Contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts across organizations with name, email, phone and organization id. Read one with ninjaone_get_contact.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_end_users
tools.title: List End Users
tools.description: Lists end users with name, email, organization and portal access. Read one with ninjaone_get_end_user.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_org_end_users
tools.title: List Org End Users
tools.description: List the end users of one organization, optionally with their roles.

tools.name: ninjaone_list_technicians
tools.title: List Technicians
tools.description: Lists technicians with name, email, roles and administrator flag. Read one with ninjaone_get_technician. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_user_roles
tools.title: List User Roles
tools.description: Lists technician or end user roles with their members. Role ids are used when creating users and changing role permissions. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_list_users
tools.title: List Users
tools.description: Lists technicians and end users together, optionally with their roles. For full records use ninjaone_list_technicians or ninjaone_list_end_users. Account-wide (not organization scoped).

tools.name: ninjaone_remove_role_members
tools.title: Remove Role Members
tools.description: Remove users from a role, which can take away their access at once. Undo with ninjaone_add_role_members. Dry run by default. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (array of integer ids) per NinjaOne removeUserRoleMembers. Example: [12, 15]. Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_set_end_user_device_access
tools.title: Set End User Device Access
tools.description: Replaces the devices an end user can access. Read the current access with ninjaone_get_end_user first. Returns it before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne patchEndUserDeviceAccess. Fields: addDeviceIds (integer[]), removeDeviceIds (integer[]). Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_set_role_org_permissions
tools.title: Set Role Org Permissions
tools.description: Replaces which organizations a role can access (body: array of organization permission items). Review the role with ninjaone_list_user_roles first. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (array of objects) per NinjaOne setOrganizationPermissions. Each item: Fields: organizationId (integer, required), permission ("default"|"noAccess"|"view"|"viewUpdate"|"viewUpdateDelete", required). Runs as a dry run unless dry_run is false: the first call returns the exact request without sending it. Destructive tier: needs NINJAONE_MODE=write, NINJAONE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_contact
tools.title: Update Contact
tools.description: Updates fields of a contact. Returns the contact before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateContact. Fields: firstName (string), lastName (string), email (string), jobTitle (string), organizationId (integer), phone (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_end_user
tools.title: Update End User
tools.description: Updates fields of an end user. Returns the user before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne patchEndUser. Fields: firstName (string), lastName (string), organizationId (integer), fullPortalAccess (boolean), managerUid (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_end_user_custom_fields
tools.title: Update End User Custom Fields
tools.description: Sets custom field values on an end user (body: map of field name to value). Returns the values before and after. Body (object) per NinjaOne updateNodeAttributeValues_3. Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_update_technician
tools.title: Update Technician
tools.description: Updates fields of a technician. Returns the technician before and after. Account-wide (not organization scoped). Body (object) per NinjaOne updateTechnician. Fields: firstName (string), lastName (string), managerUid (string). Needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

tools.name: ninjaone_view_alerts
tools.title: View Alerts
tools.description: Interactive list of active alerts with severity counts and a Reset button per alert. Reset calls ninjaone_reset_alert, which needs NINJAONE_MODE=write and is confirmed in the view. Same rows as ninjaone_list_alerts.

tools.name: ninjaone_view_device
tools.title: View Device
tools.description: Interactive device page: status, OS and hardware, volumes with usage meters, open patches and active alerts. Same data as ninjaone_get_device_profile.

tools.name: ninjaone_view_fleet
tools.title: View Fleet
tools.description: Interactive fleet health: totals and one row per organization (devices, offline share, patches pending and failed, alerts, AV threats), sortable and filterable; selecting a row asks for that client's offline devices. Same data as ninjaone_report_fleet_health, which hosts without MCP Apps receive as JSON.
